source_binding.workflow_head_rule: Execute the checked-out exact branch head and record GITHUB_SHA in raw output.

scientific_fields.claim_scope: Existential local route/state responsibility within the exact frozen four-world development protocol and TOP1_SELECTED_LOCAL_NODE_CUT_V1 intervention family; no uniqueness, specificity, completeness, sufficiency, general-superiority, formal-confirmatory, or external-generalization claim.
scientific_fields.positive_phenomenon_floor: native baseline discriminator accuracy strictly greater than 1/3
scientific_fields.primary_endpoint: delta_accuracy = baseline_accuracy - cut_accuracy over the complete discriminator split
scientific_fields.secondary_endpoint: mean total-variation distance between paired baseline and cut 3-class probability vectors
scientific_fields.reduction_direction: comparator baseline accuracy >= native baseline accuracy and comparator delta_accuracy >= native delta_accuracy
scientific_fields.capacity_limit_rule: capacity-limited comparator mismatch is INCONCLUSIVE, never native mechanism support

execution_sequence: Validate this PF-R1 contract against the frozen DEV-R2 contract before scientific execution.
Generate only the fixed development fit and calibration surfaces and train native plus dense recurrent models with the frozen seeds/budgets.
Execute native and dense calibration exactly as inherited; execute FSA immutable-table calibration diagnostics and eligibility identity/no-tunable calibration diagnostics only.
Freeze the implemented analysis path before generating or accessing the discriminator surface.
Generate the complete fixed discriminator surface exactly once for this development evaluation lineage.
Execute intervention well-posedness checks and the fixed native/dense/FSA/eligibility endpoints without post-hoc filtering.
Write target-blind raw observations before applying the fixed prospective disposition rules.
Apply the fixed disposition rules and STOP for fresh Evidence Analyst review.

runtime_recording.note: Interpreter/thread settings are deterministic execution plumbing and do not alter the frozen scientific protocol.

evidentiary_boundary.future_formal_surface_rule: Any later FORMAL object requires a fresh frozen untouched identity/evaluation surface unless a prospectively valid adaptivity regime explicitly covers this development exposure.

science_invariant_repair_allowed: implementation fixes that make code conform exactly to this already-fixed protocol without changing scientific behavior
same_revision_rules.rerun_policy: Do not repeat this fixed endpoint evaluation solely to seek a preferred outcome.

stop_rule: STOP immediately after the fixed endpoints/disposition are persisted as PRE_FORMAL development output; fresh Evidence Analyst review is required before any science-affecting redesign or FORMAL uplift.
